About

About Me

Hello! My name is Zane Bajati, and I am studying Supply Chain Management at Rutgers Business School with an expected graduation date of May 2029. I am interested in learning about how companies manage their operations, manufacturing, and distribution processes. I currently work as a server and cashier at Anthony’s Coal Fired Pizza & Wings in Wayne, NJ. This role has helped me strengthen my collaboration, communication, time management, and organizational skills. Through this experience, I have gained a better understanding of what it takes to keep a business operating efficiently. Outside of class, I am involved in multiple different clubs. I enjoy playing soccer, going to the gym, playing videogames, listening to music, and hanging out with friends. I am currently seeking an internship where I can gain experience in the supply chain industry, learn from experienced professionals, and further develop the skills necessary for my future career.
